links.comparator_used: Single prompt (SP) generating the whole discharge report in one pass
links.outcome: Expert-rated quality of AI-generated inpatient rehabilitation discharge reports (structural integrity, clinical coherence, completeness, readability; 4-point ordinal scale)
links.effect: Section-based prompt (SBP) had the highest median performance and strongest regression effect, but differences among LLM prompting strategies were not statistically significant after correction. No numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: SBP demonstrated the highest median performance and strongest regression effect, although differences among LLM-based strategies were not statistically significant after correction.
